{{Quote|We don't have any more time to waste on the ''Endor'' system.|[[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], to [[Bly/Legends|Bly]]|<ref name="What Goes Up...">{{CWACite|5|What Goes Up... (comic story)}}</ref>}}
The '''Endor system''' was home to the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]]&mdash;[[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by nine [[Moon/Legends|moons]], including the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]&mdash;and the barren [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Eloggi]], [[Megiddo]] and [[Dor]]. It was located in the [[Moddell sector/Legends|Moddell sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] at the end of the [[Sanctuary Pipeline/Legends|Sanctuary Pipeline]]. The [[Imperial Claw Station]] was located in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].

==History==
[[File:Endor_DS2_Playmat_XWM.png|thumb|left|210px|The Death Star II orbiting the Forest Moon of Endor]]
The system was rarely traveled because the gas giant exerted complex [[Gravity/Legends|gravitational]] forces on [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], and [[Star/Legends|starcharts]] contained little helpful information for navigating the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. Due to its remote location and the abundance of [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] chose to build the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] in the system.<ref name="TEA" /> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|holocron|13/comments|Major Character Birth Years}}</ref> it became the site of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="TEA" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Endor system was depicted as a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] system in the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] animated series.<ref name="Ewoks">[[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]</ref>
